description: Runs Codex as an org chart: an orchestrator plans and rules, worker subagents build, and independent checker agents verify the work.

auditor.description: Guild auditor for the constitution and task decomposition. Dispatch with an Audit-ID.

checker-courier.description: Read-only Guild courier for an independent second opinion. Dispatch with a Task-ID; its suffixed verdict never decides the task.
checker-courier.developer_instructions_suffix:
## Codex Lane Availability

The reciprocal Claude lane is not installed in this build. Fail closed: tell the parent orchestrator that the independent lane is unavailable, return no verdict, and never invoke `codex` as the far-side vendor. A Codex-hosted job calling Codex again is correlated self-review, not a second opinion.

checker-deterministic.description: Read-only Guild checker that runs only the deterministic checks named by a task. Dispatch with a Task-ID.

checker-judgment.description: Read-only Guild checker that independently evaluates judgment clauses against artifact evidence. Dispatch with a Task-ID.

hydrator.description: Guild specialist for the five-phase working-memory hydration pipeline.

worker-bulk.description: Guild worker for mechanical, zero-judgment execution. Dispatch with a Task-ID.

worker-craft.description: Guild worker for user-facing, taste-sensitive work. Dispatch with a Task-ID.

worker-standard.description: Guild worker for clear-spec implementation judged primarily on correctness. Dispatch with a Task-ID.

working-memory-synchronizer.description: Guild specialist for synchronizing working memory after material project changes.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex as a checked org chart
interface.longDescription: Plan work through an orchestrator, delegate implementation to specialist workers, and verify every result independently.
